“Ubuntu is the principle that we act humanely and with respect towards…” — Mogobe B. Ramose (Q0641)

An English quotation associated with "An African perspective on justice and race" (polylog); Ubuntu ethics, organized here under ethics.

Quotes / Mogobe B. Ramose / Q0641

English

Ubuntu is the principle that we act humanely and with respect towards others as a way of demanding the same from them.
Thinker Mogobe B. Ramose
School Africana Philosophy
Source "An African perspective on justice and race" (polylog); Ubuntu ethics
Theme Ethics

Source context

Archive record: this English passage is associated with "An African perspective on justice and race" (polylog); Ubuntu ethics, within the Africana Philosophy tradition. Use the cited work or edition when a scholarly attribution is needed.

A short reading

Read in the register of ethics, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Mogobe B. Ramose's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
